question: Who is the music director of the Oscar Award (2023) winning song 'Natu Natu'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MM Keeravani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MM Keeravani** is the music director of the Oscar Award (2023) winning song 'Natu Natu'.
 
• The song 'Natu Natu' is from the Indian Telugu-language film **RRR**, directed by S. S. Rajamouli.
 
• This song won the **Best Original Song** category at the 95th Academy Awards.
 
• MM Keeravani, also known by his alias **M. M. Kreem**, is a renowned composer and playback singer in the Indian music industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **RRR** is a fictional story about two Indian revolutionaries, Alluri Sitarama Raju and Komaram Bheem, and their fight against the British Raj.
 
• The film has been praised for its **visual effects, action sequences, and musical score**, contributing to its global recognition.
 
• MM Keeravani has composed music for many successful films and has received numerous awards, including the **National Film Award for Best Music Direction**.
 
• The song 'Natu Natu' became a cultural phenomenon, celebrated for its energetic composition and dance choreography.
